unit.why: The author's credibility statement at the end of the approbations section includes a brief memorate: R. Chaim Halberstam of Sanz seated the author beside him at the head of the table and honoured him with the zimun.

stories.summary_en: Witnesses attest that at Sanz, R. Chaim Halberstam would not sit until a bench was brought for the author at the head of the table, seated him beside him ahead of elders and great men, and honoured him with the zimun blessing; the author cites this to vouch for his stories.

quotes: עד שהביאו ספסל לראש השלחן והושיבני אצלו ממש
tags.why: The tzaddik receives and honours a visitor at his table.
The author stayed at the Sanz court.

quotes: בצאנז אצל מרן הגאוה״ק רשכב"ה מוהר"ח האלברשטאם
tags.why: The scene is set at the Sanz rebbe's table.

quotes: ידעתי נפשי מך ערכי ודלותי מאד
tags.why: The author protests his own lowliness despite the honour.

quotes: תאמינו לי בכל מה שאני מספר מהגאונים
tags.why: The passage frames the book's tales as the author's own credible telling.
The zimun grace is a liturgical act and is the honour given.
